# Route Six

> A free Pokémon team planner and playthrough guide. Team Planner supports 24 games from Generations I to VI. Progress Planner supports all 24 games.

## Interface

- [Open the planner](./): Browser application. JavaScript is required for the interactive controls.
- Team Planner: Choose up to six Pokémon. Check type weaknesses, resistances, immunities, and attack coverage with the selected game's type chart.
- Progress Planner: Select a Gym or Victory Road checkpoint. Check encounter locations, access requirements, evolutions, breeding, and optional level limits.
- Search: Find Pokémon by name, type, or Pokédex number. Regional Pokédex order comes first.
- Export: Save the team as a PNG image.

## Supported games

- Both planners: Red, Blue, Yellow, Gold, Silver, Crystal, Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, FireRed, LeafGreen, Diamond, Pearl, Platinum, Black, White, Black 2, White 2, X, Y, Omega Ruby, Alpha Sapphire, HeartGold, SoulSilver.

All game names in these lists refer to Pokémon editions. Emerald is the default game. All listed games support both planners.

## Limits

- Type analysis does not include moves, items, or abilities.
- Progress planning checks possible access within one game. Player trades, transfers, and external distribution events are outside its scope.
- Plans reset when the page reloads. PNG export keeps an image, not an editable save.
- The application uses local game data and images. No account is required.
- Route Six is an unofficial fan project.
